# Video/Decode

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Decoder.h](Decoder.h): What a decoder reports about the track it opened. (declares `VideoInfo`, `SeekMode`, `Decoder`, `makeDecoder`)
- [FrameImage.h](FrameImage.h): Copies a decoded frame into a tightly packed, straight-RGBA Image — the CPU-side view of a frame, for thumbnails, an editor's filmstrip, pixel inspection and tests. (declares `toImage`, `nativeBufferToImage`)
- [FrameStream.h](FrameStream.h): declares `StreamOptions`, `FrameStream`
- [Player.h](Player.h): A playback clock over a FrameStream: play/pause, rate, looping and a playhead, and nothing else. (declares `Player`)
- [VideoFrame.h](VideoFrame.h): The pixel layout a decoded frame arrives in. (declares `FramePixelFormat`, `framePixelBytes`, `YuvMatrix`, `YuvTransform`, `yuvTransformFor`, `yuvMatrixForHeight`, `FrameInfo`, `VideoFrame`)
